title: Flowise CSV Agent remote code execution via Pyodide code injection (CVE-2026-69255)
summary: Flowise 3.1.2 and earlier allow code injection through the CSV Agent: attacker-controlled input reaches the Pyodide Python execution environment and escapes it, achieving remote code execution on the host (root shell verified by the reporter). Affects the flowise and flowise-components npm packages. Fixed in 3.1.3.
